purpose: Separate the executable meaning actually attested by the Sanming Tonghui Dayun worked example from calendar-addition edge behavior that the reviewed source does not specify.

observed_fingerprint: 當退還本年十二月初七日
退還本年十二月初七日

witnesses.edition: 秦慎安校勘，文明書局，民國十五年[1926]

witnesses.volume_scope: 第3冊=卷之二上；第4冊=卷之二下

witnesses.current_direct_collation_scope: 論日刻/論時刻/時辰辨定

findings.source_action: The example reaches the same lunar month/day/shichen in the following year, then advances six days because six intervening months are small.
findings.executable_semantic: Within this worked-example arithmetic, each small month contributes a one-day deficit relative to the nominal 30-day-month count; six small months therefore require a +6-day correction.

findings.source_action: The example states that an intercalary fourth month makes the year contain one extra month, so the already corrected coordinate is moved back one month to restore a twelve-month count.
findings.executable_semantic: An intercalary insertion participates in elapsed lunisolar-month counting as an additional actual month; a nominal next-year same-month anchor can therefore overcount by one month.

findings.source_action: After the first handover coordinate, the passage says the next luck frame changes only after ten full anniversaries.
findings.executable_semantic: The textual recurrence unit is anniversary-based from the first handover, not an arbitrary Gregorian ten-year timestamp.

findings.question: If a carried target day number is 30 and the target month has only 29 days, what exact historical action is taken?
When a month number appears twice as regular and intercalary, which identity is the intended target/anniversary when the target month itself has that duplicated label?
findings.source_limit: The worked example contains an intercalary fourth month, but its target handover coordinate is not a duplicated fourth-month target.

findings.question: How is anniversary identity preserved when the birth or first-handover anchor itself lies in an intercalary month?

findings.executable_semantic: The example proves that the intercalary insertion is traversed as an extra real month in elapsed-month counting.
findings.unresolved_semantic: The text does not provide a typed regular/intercalary month identity rule sufficient for arbitrary target selection.

MD-G07-INVALID-TARGET-DATE-POLICY.refinement: The small-month deficit correction is explicit, but invalid carried day numbers remain source-unresolved.

MD-G08-INTERCALARY-MONTH-IDENTITY-AND-TR.refinement: Aggregate intercalary-month insertion/traversal is explicit; typed regular-versus-intercalary duplicate identity and target selection remain unresolved.

MD-G10-TEN-YEAR-RECURRENCE-SAME-REGIME.refinement: The ten-anniversary textual rule is closed, but executable recurrence still depends on the unresolved invalid-date/intercalary-identity/multi-year calendar gates.

next_research_priority.focus: Audit dynamic D1 precision generalization beyond the single 1596 Datong worked example. Seek additional Ming authorial/official arithmetic controls or boundary-sensitive physical-almanac cases; do not promote one local printed precision pattern to a universal runtime rule.
